## Monitor failed Sellf webhook deliveries and auto-retry them

### How it works
Webhooks fail quietly - a receiver was down for a minute and your invoice/CRM automation silently missed a sale. Every hour this workflow lists your [Sellf](https://github.com/jurczykpawel/sellf) - a self-hosted checkout platform for digital products webhook endpoints, pulls each one's failed delivery logs, alerts you on Telegram with the endpoint and the failed events, and immediately queues a retry for up to five failed deliveries per endpoint through the Sellf API. Self-healing plumbing for everything else you've built on Sellf webhooks.

### Setup
1. In Sellf admin create an API key (**Settings → API keys**) with the webhooks scopes.
2. Fill in **Configuration (EDIT ME)**: your Sellf URL, the API key and your Telegram chat id.
3. Connect your Telegram bot credentials on **Alert on Telegram**.
4. Activate.

### Customization tips
Raise the retry cap in **Split Log IDs** (5 per endpoint per run by default). Don't want auto-retries? Delete the retry branch and keep the alerts. Swap Telegram for Slack/Discord via an incoming-webhook HTTP node.

## Scan Deliveries
Hourly: one API call lists every failed webhook delivery across all endpoints.

## Alert & Retry
You get the failure summary on Telegram while the workflow queues retries for up to 5 deliveries per endpoint.
